en: Find and kill Mek Blitzzagga. He may lead you to the Astronomic Array.
zh_new: 找到並殺死技霸布利札嘎。他可能會帶你找到天文陣列。

en: Advance to the Astronomic Array to initiate a data uplink with the battle barge
zh_new: 前進至天文陣列，與戰鬥駁船建立資料上傳鏈路

en: This lieutenant is an Ork Mek that has been supplying Rippa-Splitta’s horde with heavy weapons.
zh_new: 這名副官是一名獸人技霸，一直在為殘虐裂手的部落供應重型武器。

en: Techpriests have located a powerful Astronomic Array on Planet Typhon. This array can identify a weakness in the Tyranid Hive Fleet.
zh_new: 技術神甫在泰豐上發現了一座強大的天文陣列。這座陣列能找出泰倫蟲族蟲巢艦隊的弱點。

en: You have located Blitzzagga, an Ork Mek and lieutenant of Rippa-Splitta. He is your only lead in the search for the astronomic array and finding a weakness in the Hive Fleet.
zh_new: 你已找到布利札嘎，一名獸人技霸，也是殘虐裂手的副官。他是你尋找天文陣列、找出蟲巢艦隊弱點的唯一線索。

en: You finally have the location of the astronomic array. You must obtain the data from this array to find a weakness in the hive fleet.
zh_new: 你終於掌握了天文陣列的位置。你必須從這座陣列取得數據，以找出蟲巢艦隊的弱點。
